srcZh: 国家版权局（甘肃省版权局）

sumEn: It compiles 100 Q&A on the Copyright Law and its implementation regulations, introduces the statutory scope of works and the fundamental role of copyright in innovation, culture and the economy, encouraging the public to learn and apply the law.

srcZh: 国家知识产权局（知识产权报）
